exposure: All in-patient, out-patient and emergency room psychiatric contacts among people born after 1995
outcome: out-patient and emergency room psychiatric contacts
finding: Birth by caesarean section was associated with a very slightly increased risk of any in-patient psychiatric admission for the offspring.
mod_finding: The risk of any in-patient psychiatric admission was comparable when comparing prelabour versus intrapartum caesarean section and acute versus planned caesarean section.
